purpose: Independently rederive all file and symlink identities in an explicit installed/deployed source tree before Node static imports. A manifest hash alone is not source identity.
format: Small summary records canonical root, deterministic tree_sha256, file_count, directory_count, symlink_count, total_file_bytes, maximum_mtime_ns. Full census is recomputed from actual opened bytes; no self-reportedmemberpass flag.
tree: Include every entry, including hidden/package metadata, in sorted relative POSIX path order. Regular files openednofollow boundedwithpre/postfstat, symlinks bindliteral target andmustresolvewithinroot. No specialfiles, out-of-root symlink, invalidpath, unstableinode/content orundeclaredignoredpaths.
exclusions: None within declared root. System Node/kernel executable and OS sharedlibraries remain explicit separatelybound/trustedplatform, not implied inthis tree.
safety: No imports or execution of external tree, no auth/data/profile root. InstalledPrimeandcopiedtasksource only. Nativeconstruction unchanged.
